findings.title: Select-all event semantics depend on unseen Apply behavior
findings.message: Select-all applies the node's SelectionChange to every enabled option, but Apply is built from ListSelectionEvent with IDs only. The ListSelectionEvent carries no Range/Mode field, so how Apply interprets IDs with TargetID=id is unclear. If Apply treats an event with TargetID and no modifiers as an ordinary click (replace with a single target), select-all would not work. The tests cover only the happy path.
findings.suggestion: Verify that Apply replaces the selection with IDs when IDs is non-empty. Add an explicit test for Apply with an empty enabled set.
